canonical_policies.name: devedores_solidarios_gestor_select_multifundo
canonical_policies.qual:
((get_user_role() = 'gestor'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM cedente_fundos cf
  WHERE ((cf.cedente_id = devedores_solidarios.cedente_id) AND (cf.status = 'ativo'::text) AND private.usuario_tem_acesso_fundo(cf.fundo_id)))))

canonical_policies.name: eventos_dominio_gestor_select
canonical_policies.qual:
((get_user_role() = 'gestor'::text) AND (visibilidade = ANY (ARRAY['interno'::text, 'ambos'::text])) AND ((fundo_id IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM usuario_fundos uf
  WHERE ((uf.usuario_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (uf.fundo_id = eventos_dominio.fundo_id) AND (uf.status = 'ativo'::text))))))

canonical_policies.name: eventos_dominio_insert
canonical_policies.with_check:
(((get_user_role() = 'gestor'::text) AND ((fundo_id IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM usuario_fundos uf
  WHERE ((uf.usuario_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (uf.fundo_id = eventos_dominio.fundo_id) AND (uf.status = 'ativo'::text)))))) OR ((get_user_role() = 'cedente'::text) AND (cedente_id = get_user_cedente_id()) AND (visibilidade = ANY (ARRAY['cedente'::text, 'ambos'::text]))) OR ((get_user_role() = 'sacado'::text) AND (visibilidade = 'ambos'::text) AND (((nota_fiscal_id IS NOT NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM notas_fiscais nf
  WHERE ((nf.id = eventos_dominio.nota_fiscal_id) AND (nf.cnpj_destinatario = get_user_sacado_cnpj()))))) OR ((operacao_id IS NOT NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (operacoes_nfs onf
     JOIN notas_fiscais nf ON ((nf.id = onf.nota_fiscal_id)))
  WHERE ((onf.operacao_id = eventos_dominio.operacao_id) AND (nf.cnpj_destinatario = get_user_sacado_cnpj()))))))))

canonical_policies.name: eventos_dominio_sacado_select
canonical_policies.qual:
((get_user_role() = 'sacado'::text) AND (visibilidade = ANY (ARRAY['cedente'::text, 'ambos'::text])) AND (((nota_fiscal_id IS NOT NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM notas_fiscais nf
  WHERE ((nf.id = eventos_dominio.nota_fiscal_id) AND (NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(nf.cnpj_destinatario, ''::text), '\D'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text), ''::text) = get_user_sacado_cnpj()))))) OR ((operacao_id IS NOT NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (operacoes_nfs onf
     JOIN notas_fiscais nf ON ((nf.id = onf.nota_fiscal_id)))
  WHERE ((onf.operacao_id = eventos_dominio.operacao_id) AND (NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(nf.cnpj_destinatario, ''::text), '\D'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text), ''::text) = get_user_sacado_cnpj())))))))
